messages:
jana: quick check — we have sporadic client errors when the /v2/generate response omits the `summary` key. some SDKs treat missing as undefined, others coerce to null and that breaks a downstream mapper. can we decide a single behavior?
owen: what do the current servers return for empty content? iirc we sometimes send `summary: ""` and other times we drop the key.
sophie: yep, verified. earlier rollout for compact-responses dropped empty strings to reduce payload. that caused the JS sdk to throw when it expected a string.
jana: proposal: contract says optional fields may be omitted, but for consumer-facing human fields (summary, title) we should normalise to empty string when there is no content. for structured arrays (results) keep empty array.
own: +1 for stable shapes, but worried about NDJSON/streaming paths where we emit partial objects — adding empty string might be confusing.
sophie: streaming case: we already stream partial chunks like `{"id":123,"summary":"par...` so if final chunk resolves to no summary, we'd end with `"summary":""` which seems fine.
jana: also content-type chestnut — some proxies strip charset. clients look for application/json; we should not rely on charset. add guidance in api-lint.
own: pragmatic change: update server layer to coerce missing -> empty string for the documented fields before marshalling. I'll open a tiny PR and add a feature flag.
sophie: can you include this mapping in the jsonschema? maybe add a new `x-shape` vendor extension: `x-normalize-empty: "to-empty-string"` so SDKS and linters can pick it up.
api-bot: lint-result — schema/contract-lint FAILED for /v2/generate: missing `summary` required-ness mismatch (line 42).
own: thanks bot. leaning to just update runtime + schema `examples` and a note in changelog. low-risk.
jana: ok next steps: owen to PR runtime coercion + tests, sophie to add schema extension and api-lint rule, i'll update the migration note and ping SDK owners.
own: aiming to cut the PR today, will ping reviewers.
sophie: i'll add test cases for streaming smoke and ndjson consumer. can we agree to backfill a small integration test in sdks repo?
jana: yes — i'll file a follow-up issue and assign SDK owners.
own: tagging @owen for action, will add :arrow_up: label on the PR when ready.
sophie: :thumbsup:
jana: thanks all, closing the loop here.
